title: Digital Marketing Internship in Secunderabad, Hyderabad
Digital Marketing Executive - Thinking Team - Secunderabad
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive
   

  

 Company Name: Thinking Team Pvt Ltd
   

  

 Location: Secunderabad
   

  

 Salary: INR 2\.5\-3\.5 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you a creative and results\-driven Digital Marketing professional seeking a new challenge? Thinking Team Pvt Ltd is looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our team in the beautiful city of Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. With 1 to 3 years of experience, you can be part of our dynamic digital marketing team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across various platforms.
   

  

 Create compelling content for websites, social media, and email marketing.
   

  

 Analyze campaign performance and make data\-driven optimizations.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve marketing goals.
   

  

 Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 1 to 3 years of experience in digital marketing.
   

  

 Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies and tools.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
   

  

 Join us at Thinking Team Pvt Ltd and be part of an innovative and growth\-focused digital marketing environment.
   

  

**FAQs**
 Q: What is the salary range for this position?
   

  

 A: The salary for this position is in the range of INR 2\.5\-3\.5 Lacs per annum.
   

  

 Q: Is this a remote or on\-site position?
   

  

 A: This is an on\-site position located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
   

  

 Q: What qualifications are required for this role?
   

  

 A: We require candidates to have 1 to 3 years of experience in digital marketing and hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
